name: Chimeric Labs
base: Nocturne structure on Field Lab v3 tokens
tokenSource: assets/field-lab/tokens.css (generated; the only file allowed to hold colour literals)

fonts.mono: IBM Plex Mono, labels and figures

radius: square plates; --radius-sm 2px for controls; pills only for status
elevation: hard offset stamp shadows, never blurred
buttons: outlined; one filled accent action per view (fl-btn--primary)
accentRule: accent is a line, dot or glow; never a flood; text uses --accent-ink
motion: one easing (--ease); respect prefers-reduced-motion; pause off-screen work
